density.$description: Density axis: COMFORTABLE (default). Density scales spacing/sizing component tokens only, never colour (BR-BW-TOK-004). Same token names as the compact/spacious files. Selected via [data-density='comfortable'] (the default, also emitted on :root).

rail-width.$description: Capability rail resting width for layout=regions and bw_nav_rail density=icons (brickwork#700/#701). 3.25rem = 52px.

rail-width-expanded.$description: Capability rail width on hover/focus-within expand (brickwork#701). 13.75rem = 220px.
